findings.title: Official Start pins a turn-specific completion event in the session System
findings.trigger: An official-client session starts while current Completion_authority contains approval or rejection, then resumes a later owner turn without that event. This can occur on a fresh or failed-over official session consuming a durable outcome.

source.fact: Exact authority layer becomes a System observation.
Observation text is appended to the effective System without a native/official Start distinction.

findings.impact: The original turn event can remain in vendor standing System after its queue acknowledgement and later turns, while local current-turn assembly no longer records it. Sent_every_resume correctly sends events that exist; it cannot remove an event already pinned in the initial System. This violates the requested turn-local retention boundary and current input provenance.
findings.bounded_repair: Keep ordinary HTTP System observations and Goal Start/held semantics. Exclude Completion Authority from official standing System at Start and deliver its current event as a separately issued User observation with exact source/target proof. Update Start-to-absent and Start-to-changed-event fixtures. A known-empty User notice alone cannot remove the original standing System event. Do not claim a physical System/Extra carrier for text actually sent through another carrier.
findings.evidence_scope: Actual pure assembler/projection output plus exact adapter retention policy source. No Host/native vendor process or model execution was performed by this reviewer.

checked_successes: Exact renderer partition/text equality and unique Dynamic ID prevent unproven promotion.
Private issued observation list has only Goal/Completion Authority variants and rejects duplicate kinds.
Production before-hook uses per-turn accumulator; SDK starts fresh default params each provider round, so suffixes do not accumulate.
Task/Gate/Lane/clock retain first-round-only suppression; later System observations reuse only previous current-turn assembly.
No-Goal/no-authority combinations, None versus Some empty, override preservation, immutable post-tool snapshots, malformed UTF8 normalization, byte offsets and hashes pass actual-source probes.
Official current-present Resume authority retransmission and Goal held omission use separate exact System spans, including combined Unicode data.
Logical block accounting, closed block decoders, forecast classification and TUI/dashboard identities were traced; no additional P0-P2 found there.
